scope: DuckDB nested result decoding and LIST<ENUM> refusal
observed_before_fix: LIST<ENUM> decoding called DuckDB ValueRef::data_type on a dictionary child and panicked with not implemented: Dictionary(UInt8, Utf8).
contract: Nested LIST, STRUCT, ARRAY, MAP and UNION results map to the existing Undecodable marker without calling nested data_type().
A LIST<ENUM> result is explicitly Undecodable(LIST); SQL literal rendering and parameter rebinding refuse it.
Native typeof and to_json preserve the ENUM list labels, Unicode, empty label, literal NULL label and SQL NULL element.

strict_value_matrix.result: 338 tests passed across 11 suites; no missing suites; GTK and DuckDB enabled

clippy.command: rtk cargo clippy --locked -p tablepro-driver-duckdb -p tablepro-app --features duckdb --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Nested DuckDB values, including LIST<ENUM>, remain unsupported by type-less app consumers; this change prevents a decoder panic and does not close B3 or qualify the 0.2.0 release.
